watches.name: Cestrian Pro Dive Series 42mm Blue Fumé Dial Silicone Strap Automatic 300m Men's Watch
watches.description: The Cestrian Pro Dive Series marks the introduction of a purpose-built professional dive platform, designed from the ground up to deliver serious underwater capability while maintaining everyday wearability. Built around a robust 42mm 316L stainless steel case and engineered for 300 metres of water resistance, the Pro Dive is designed to perform reliably in demanding real-world environments — from daily wear to extended time in the water. A unidirectional 120-click ceramic bezel provides precise timing functionality with enhanced durability and scratch resistance, while the luminous bezel triangle and high-visibility markers ensure strong legibility in low-light conditions. A flat sapphire crystal with triple internal anti-reflective coating improves clarity while maintaining the strength expected of a professional dive watch. The grain-textured matte blue dial is engineered for maximum underwater legibility, offering depth of tone while reducing glare beneath the surface. Applied indices and a polished handset create strong contrast against the dial, while generous Swiss Super-LumiNova ensures excellent low-light visibility. The balanced layout preserves the purposeful, instrument-led character that defines the Pro Dive Series. Powering the watch is the proven Miyota 8215 automatic movement, selected for its durability, serviceability, and dependable long-term performance. Featuring hacking seconds and manual winding capability, it offers approximately 42 hours of power reserve and accuracy suited to everyday use. Completing this version is a black Cestrian-branded silicone strap, finished with the Cestrian shield and designed for resilience in demanding conditions. Flexible, durable, and comfortable on the wrist, it is secured with a classic pin buckle for a secure fit — reinforcing the Pro Dive’s role as a serious professional tool watch built for consistent real-world performance.

watches.name: Cestrian Ocean Series GMT 42mm Black Dial Silicone Strap Automatic Men's Watch
watches.description: The Ocean Series GMT continues Cestrian’s philosophy of building dependable, purpose-driven watches designed for real-world use, combining robust dive-watch capability with the added practicality of a second time-zone function. Engineered as a true everyday sports watch, it balances durability, legibility, and versatility in a format that feels equally at home on land, in the water, or during travel. At its core is the reliable NH34 automatic GMT movement, chosen for its proven performance and ease of service, allowing the wearer to track a second time zone with clarity and precision. The solid stainless-steel case is built to withstand daily wear and demanding conditions, supported by a screw-down crown, sapphire crystal, and 200 metres of water resistance, ensuring the watch remains ready for adventure without compromise. The black sunray dial introduces a refined sense of depth, shifting subtly under changing light to reveal a radial brushed texture that enhances both legibility and visual presence. Applied nickel-plated hour markers add dimensionality against the deep black surface, while polished hands maintain a clean, purposeful aesthetic. Generous Swiss Super-LumiNova ensures strong low-light performance, with the contrasting luminous GMT hand providing clear secondary time-zone readability without disrupting the dial’s balanced, instrument-focused design. Completing this version is a black Cestrian-branded silicone strap, finished with the Cestrian shield and engineered for durability, flexibility, and all-day comfort. Secured with a classic pin buckle for a dependable fit, it enhances the watch’s sport-driven character while offering lightweight practicality for travel, water use, and daily wear. Like every Ocean Series model, this piece is built with longevity and usability in mind — a capable, travel-ready dive watch that prioritises function, reliability, and honest value.

watches.name: Cestrian Ocean Series GMT 42mm Black Dial Steel Bracelet Automatic Men's Watch
watches.description: The Ocean Series GMT continues Cestrian’s philosophy of building dependable, purpose-driven watches designed for real-world use, combining robust dive-watch capability with the added practicality of a second time-zone function. Engineered as a true everyday sports watch, it balances durability, legibility, and versatility in a format that feels equally at home on land, in the water, or during travel. At its core is the reliable NH34 automatic GMT movement, chosen for its proven performance and ease of service, allowing the wearer to track a second time zone with clarity and precision. The solid stainless-steel case is built to withstand daily wear and demanding conditions, supported by a screw-down crown, sapphire crystal, and 200 metres of water resistance, ensuring the watch remains ready for adventure without compromise. The black sunray dial introduces a refined sense of depth, shifting subtly under changing light to reveal a radial brushed texture that enhances both legibility and visual presence. Applied nickel-plated hour markers add dimensionality against the deep black surface, while polished hands maintain a clean, purposeful aesthetic. Generous Swiss Super-LumiNova ensures strong low-light performance, with the contrasting luminous GMT hand providing clear secondary time-zone readability without disrupting the dial’s balanced, instrument-focused design. Completing the watch is a fully brushed stainless-steel bracelet engineered for durability and comfort, featuring a secure deployment clasp and practical micro-adjustment for daily wear. Like every Ocean Series model, this piece is built with longevity and usability in mind — a capable travel-ready dive watch that prioritises function, reliability, and honest value.

watches.name: Cestrian Master Series V3 40mm White Textured Dial Steel Bracelet Automatic Men's Watch
watches.description: The Master Series V3 represents the next evolution of Cestrian’s everyday watch — refined through real-world use, customer feedback, and a clear focus on what actually matters on the wrist. Designed as a true go-anywhere, do-anything timepiece, the V3 balances versatility, durability, and understated design in a way that allows it to transition effortlessly from daily wear to more demanding environments. It’s a watch built to be worn, relied upon, and enjoyed — not babied. At its heart is the Miyota 8215 automatic movement with hacking, selected for its long-term reliability, robust construction, and proven track record within the industry. It’s a movement chosen through careful consideration — not trends. The 316L stainless steel case has been subtly reworked for a slimmer, more refined profile while retaining a confident presence on the wrist. With 200 metres of water resistance and a screw-down crown, the Master Series V3 is more than capable of handling daily knocks, water exposure, and extended wear without compromise. The white textured dial introduces additional visual depth through a finely grained surface pattern that interacts subtly with changing light conditions. This texture enhances character while preserving the clean, high-contrast readability expected from the Master Series, creating a dial that feels both contemporary and distinctly technical. A fully brushed, tapered three-link stainless steel bracelet completes the design, offering comfort, durability, and a utilitarian aesthetic that suits the watch’s all-round character. The deployment clasp ensures a secure fit while remaining easy to wear throughout the day. The Master Series V3 isn’t about excess. It’s about refinement — taking a proven platform and making it better in every meaningful way. A considered evolution, built to last, and priced to remain accessible without cutting corners.
